question: Mayadhar Raut is an exponent of the Indian classical dance form __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mayadhar Raut** is a renowned exponent of the Indian classical dance form **Odissi**.
 
• He has played a pivotal role in reviving and popularizing **Odissi** dance.
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of **Odisha**.
 
• This dance form is characterized by its fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and intricate footwork.
 
• Mayadhar Raut's contributions have been instrumental in bringing global recognition to **Odissi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi** is known for its grace and expressiveness, often depicting themes from Hindu mythology.
 
• The dance form is performed primarily to the accompaniment of **Odissi music**, which is a classical music genre from Odisha.
 
• Mayadhar Raut has also been a distinguished teacher, mentoring many successful Odissi dancers.
 
• His dedication to the art form has earned him numerous awards and accolades, including the **Padma Shri**.
 
• Odissi dancers typically wear elaborate costumes and jewelry, and the performances often include both solo and group presentations.
